## Hive 0.6.0 — delegate to projects, and what's new
Agents can now hand work to a whole project, not only to a session that is already open, and Hive tells you what changed after each update.
### New
- **Automatic delegation (experimental, off by default).** In an organization's profile you can turn on "Approve and open sessions automatically". With it on, a Claude Code agent can list the organization's projects and delegate a task or mention to a project. Hive approves it on its own and, if the project has no Claude session, opens one in a separate worktree. Turning it on asks you to confirm the risk, and you can turn it off at any time from the right panel. - **Delegated sessions are marked.** Sessions that Hive opened for a delegation show a mark in the tab and in the tree, with the project they came from. - **"Needs a session" notification.** If Hive could not open a session for a delegated task, it tells you which project is waiting. A waiting task is dropped after 10 minutes. - **What's new.** The first time you open a new version, Hive shows its highlights. You can open it again from Help › What's New in Hive. - **Clickable links in the terminal.** Links are underlined when you hover them. Hold ⌘ and click to open one. - **Right panel redrawn.** Requests and PRs follow the rest of the app, and the PRs tab shows a loading state while it fetches.
### Improved
- The "default account" notice on the PRs tab is now a card. - The requests panel shows when automatic approval is on, with a shortcut to turn it off.
### Fixed
- The Agent Board could hang the app when macOS was set to always show scroll bars.
### Security
- Automatic mode never turns on from an agent or from a command line: only from the organization's profile, after you confirm. - Hive never accepts a folder trust prompt for you. A session opened by delegation waits until you answer it in the terminal. - Automatic delegation only works inside one organization, and a project from another organization looks the same as one that does not exist.
### Known limits
- When several sessions are opened by delegation at the same time, the first message to a new session may not be confirmed within 10 seconds, and Hive does not resend it. Ask the sending agent again if that happens. - Not yet verified: organizations with their own Claude config folder (the trust prompt may appear more often), macOS 14 and 15, and VoiceOver on the new screens. - A program running as you on this Mac can change Hive's local settings file, including this option. Turn it on only where you trust the agents you run.
---
*Hive is made by Zeep Labs.*

## Hive 0.5.0 — a new look, a welcome and tips
Hive has a new visual identity, an opening animation, a short introduction for new users and contextual tips.
### New
- **New look, "Favo".** A floating layout with no title bar, rounded cards for the sidebar, terminals and right panel, a honey accent color, and light and dark themes. "Increase contrast" in macOS is respected. - **Opening animation.** Hive opens with a short animation (about 1.7 seconds). With "Reduce motion" on, it is a quick fade instead. - **Introduction.** The first time you open Hive with no projects, a seven-step introduction shows the tree, terminals, agents, delegation between agents and the main shortcuts. Open it again any time from Help › Show Introduction or Settings › General. If you already have projects, it is not shown. - **Tips.** Three short tips appear in context: splitting the workspace, the agent board and dropping files into a terminal. At most one per session, and you can turn them off or see them again in Settings › General. - **Agent status cell.** Each agent shows its state in a small hexagon, in the tree and in the tabs. - **Resources per pane.** Every terminal pane has its own small resource capsule. - **Mascot.** The Hive bee now shows up in empty screens, such as an empty project, the requests panel, the board and the PRs tab. - **Remove unavailable worktrees.** Worktrees that git no longer lists can be dropped from the tree in one step. - **Sidebar shortcut.** Show or hide the sidebar with ⌃⌘S, or with the icon on its card.
### Improved
- A tab holds at most four panes, in a 2×2 grid, so terminals stay readable. - The search field and the right-panel tabs follow the new style, with a clear focus ring. - The requests panel always shows its sections, without the "for this session" filter. - Window size is kept when you collapse the sidebar. - A new Help menu with the introduction and the tips.
### Known limits
- Not yet verified: macOS 14 and 15, VoiceOver on the new screens, and typing or clicking a notification during the opening animation. - The introduction and tips are in English and Portuguese only, like the rest of the app.
---
*Hive is made by Zeep Labs.*

## Hive 0.4.0 — English and Portuguese
Hive now speaks English and Portuguese, and you can choose which one in Settings.
### New
- **English and Portuguese.** Hive opens in the first language of your macOS list that it supports (English or Portuguese), and in English when there is none. Menus, windows, alerts, tooltips and accessibility labels are translated. - **Language setting.** Settings › General has a Language menu: System (the default), English and Portuguese. A change takes effect after Hive restarts, and Hive offers to restart for you. If terminal sessions are open it asks first, because they are ended and come back as ended sessions, like on any relaunch.
### Improved
- **Heads-up: the default language is now English** for anyone whose macOS language is not Portuguese. If your Mac is in English, Hive opens in English after updating; pick Portuguese in Settings › General to keep it in Portuguese. - The messages Hive types into an agent's terminal (the task and mention headers and the instruction to finish) and the readable errors it returns to agents follow the language. Tool names and the rest of the protocol stay in English. - Dates, times and numbers follow the app language, and dates use your system region (24-hour clock and day/month on a Mac set to Brazil). - A few Portuguese labels were renamed for consistency, for example in terminal splits and in the delegation detail sheet. - Git errors and the time of a GitHub rate limit follow the language. What `git` itself prints is shown as it is.
### Known limits
- The language change needs a restart; it is not applied live. No other languages yet. - Not yet verified: macOS 14 and 15, a Mac whose system language is English, opening the app from the downloaded disk image right after changing the language, and delegation between real agents in both languages.
---
*Hive is made by Zeep Labs.*
